params.body:
A task's lifecycle state is read under its key, then its former key (the card's slug until brief version 3), then its former Dutch title. `Worklist::setState('open')` removed only the new key. A state stored under an older key therefore survived every reset.

Elixir's `Werkstatus` still writes under `packages`. On the De Backer website, `task.mjs --key vuln:runtime --state open` (and with `--key packages`, which resolves to the same task) answered "open", while the task kept showing "in progress" on a pull request merged four weeks before.

Changes:

- Each task now carries `stateAliases`, the older keys its state may be stored under.
- `setState` clears those aliases whatever the new state, so the new key is the only row. Both callers pass them: the ingest door and the owner's work-status form.

Tests: one new case in `IngestTaskTest`; it fails without the fix. The full suite passes 621 of 622; the one failure, `BuildStampTest`, also fails without this change because it reads the git checkout. PHPStan reports 0 errors.

params.title: Clear a task's state under its former keys too
